xml/internal/events#

The events of a whole XML document (#144, #13): a bounded, non-validating tokenizer that checks the document is well formed and hands xml/parse and plist/parse its events.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let events = XmlTokens(origin: text, maximum_depth: 256, maximum_events: 1048576).events();
events.error();                       // "" when well formed
for events.items() -> event { … }

Description#

The events of a whole XML document (#144, #13): a bounded, non-validating tokenizer that checks the document is well formed and hands xml/parse and plist/parse its events. There is no DTD: a DOCTYPE with an internal subset is refused and an external one is never fetched, so the only entities are the five predefined ones and character references. Depth and the number of events are bounded. Line ends become LF (XML 1.0 2.11) and attribute values turn tabs and line ends into spaces. Offsets count characters.

Internal to the xml and plist modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

enum XmlEvent#

enum XmlEvent = (start(name is string, names is @string, values is @string, offset is int), end(name is string, offset is int), text(value is string, offset is int), comment(value is string, offset is int), instruction(target is string, data is string, offset is int))

One event: a start tag with its attributes in order, an end tag, text (adjacent text and CDATA joined), a comment or a processing instruction inside the root element. Each knows the character offset where it starts.
